# CityMETER · Factory

> DIW-reported workers at every core factory registration of the research master across Thailand by district (เขต/อำเภอ), from the DIW class 2/3 open-data registry (registrations outside IEAT industrial estates), the registrations the Ministry of Industry records as operating and its location status, with official DIW industry groups, worker bands (incl. the 95+ lens), functional classes, the industrial-area register as context, and a nearby set per registration. Since release 0.6.0 (2026-11-10) the 46 industrial-estate outlines of CityMETER Industrial Estate (OpenStreetMap, the estate master's demo selection) are drawn as context, ?d=factory&e=estate:<estate_id> opens an estate with the registrations within 3 km of its outline (a distance set, never membership), and every estate links to the estate demo (industrialestate/llms.txt). Since release 0.7.0 (2026-11-10) 221 registrations carry a site: the CityMETER buildings inside the OpenStreetMap works area that holds their published point and no other (data/factory-sites.json, checked by rule and sampled against imagery; © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL), so the building view shows the whole factory, not only the building nearest the pin. Since release 0.7.1 (2026-11-10) the estate context follows the estate demo's R8 review: recovered and new estate, parent or developer logos (the Bluetech artwork, an unrelated company's, is no longer used), and English names published by the developers. Since release 0.9.0 (2026-11-16) a FID without a DIW worker figure takes the MOI TOTAL_WORKER (2,923 FIDs, 631,627 workers), always shown apart from the DIW figures, and registrations without a DIW industry group are their own neutral family. A Landometer CityMETER public demo, release 0.2.0 (2026-11-05). Research master checked 2026-11-16.

What one figure means:
- workers (คน) = Σ worker figures of the registrations: the DIW registry's คนงานรวม first (71,124 FIDs; no date for the figure in the open data) and, since release 0.9.0 (2026-11-16), the Ministry of Industry's TOTAL_WORKER (ข้อมูลโรงงานอุตสาหกรรม, GD Catalog ops_13_01) only for the 2,923 FIDs without a DIW figure; its LAST_UPDATE is a row update date, not a count date. Every figure names its source (the อก. tag; the split “กรอ. … · อก. เติม …” under totals). A registration without any figure would add nothing and never show as 0. Not current employment, a labour market, residents, capacity or output.
- registrations (ทะเบียน) = factory registration numbers (FID) of the research tab 02_FACTORIES (74,047 core FIDs). A registration is not a verified plant, a company or proof of operation today.
- 95+ lens (?size=p90) = the registrations with 95 workers or more: 95 is the P90 of the 71,124 DIW figures (the research tab 18_WORKERS_P90, 7,175 FIDs) and stays fixed when MOI fills a figure — 8,727 registrations holding 69% of the workers (release 0.9.0). Never a P90 of the MOI figures.
- scope = DIW open-data class 2/3 exports, which cover registrations outside IEAT industrial estates, plus 2,921 registrations only the MOI records as operating; plants registered with IEAT are not in this dataset.
- status = the Ministry of Industry's location status (GD Catalog) with its date; not a field check.
- industry = the official DIW industry group per type code; ten families group them for the map's colour and shape cue. A registration without a DIW group (3,114, of them 2,921 MOI-only) is “ไม่ระบุกลุ่มอุตสาหกรรม” (family unstated, neutral, never ranked as an industry) since release 0.9.0.
- points = source points screened inside Thailand and inside the registration's own district (others withheld); not verified plant locations. Distances are straight lines.
- districts = CityMETER production districts (codes as in https://landometer.com/v3/citymeter/{province}/D/{district}?d=factory).

Snapshot (release 0.9.0; fixtures, recompute from data):
- 74,047 registrations, 4,387,259 workers (DIW 3,755,632 for 71,124 FIDs + MOI 631,627 for 2,923), 915 of 928 districts, 77 of 77 provinces; 15,654 registrations with a published point.
- Samut Prakan: 75% of the province's workers (400,991 of 537,271; DIW 323,654 + MOI 77,337) are in Mueang Samut Prakan, Bang Phli and Bang Sao Thong; their industries: vehicles and machinery 16%, plastics/rubber/chemicals 13%, textiles/apparel/leather 11%, group not stated 19%. With the 95+ lens: 76% (281,941 of 370,538); DIW figures alone 74% (220,980 of 299,796) as in release 0.1.0.
- The district with the most workers: Mueang Samut Sakhon (289,471; 38% in food and beverages).

Deep links (https://montri-th.github.io/factory/):
- ?metric=count — measure registrations instead of workers
- ?province={code} — e.g. SPK, SKN, CBI (production codes)
- ?area={district code} — e.g. 1103 (อำเภอบางพลี)
- ?areas={code},{code} | ?areas=all — focus districts / every district
- ?group={food|electrical|vehicle|textile|metal|polymer|wood|mineral|plant|other} · ?size={p90|s1|s2|s3|w1…w6|none} · ?cls={manufacturing|service|other|review}
- ?factory={FID} · ?view={areas|mix|industries} · ?search={text}

Data and method:
- [Product statement](https://montri-th.github.io/factory/PRODUCT_STATEMENT.md): users, problem, claim boundary
- [Data and method](https://montri-th.github.io/factory/DATA_METHOD.md): sources, measures, district matching, context, limits
- [Dataset](https://montri-th.github.io/factory/data/factories.json): columnar rows + dictionaries + provenance (meta)
- [Developer handoff](https://montri-th.github.io/factory/handoff/START_HERE.md)

Map reading: symbol area grows with workers; colour and shape = industry family; names near the middle of the view rank by workers; buildings per local administration from CityMETER Building V4 where the CityMETER: Hotel units decided it, else OpenStreetMap; choosing a registration with a point opens a two-point perspective of its building (or the nearest drawn building — a camera choice, not a claim).

Do not claim from this data: employment today, labour supply, wages, production capacity, output, revenue, that a factory is open today, that a district without registrations has no factories, anything about plants inside IEAT estates, or which registration lies inside an industrial estate.
